guardrail_violations.note: Guardrails are surfaced via Evaluator.record_guardrail_violation; current v11 scripts do not call any LLM and therefore do not exercise the LLM-side guardrails (hallucination, safety). The numerical guardrails (Lyapunov-decay, ODE-solver tolerance, Mondrian per-stratum coverage) are enforced INSIDE the scripts and recorded as PASS/FAIL in the per-sprint JSONs (e.g. F8_strict_pass=false in v11_sprint7/f8_neural_ode.json), not via the Evaluator API.

optimization.reason: Optimization metrics in resistancemap/agentops/optimizer.py target prompt-token efficiency, retrieval@k, agent-handoff success, and flow efficiency for LLM-driven flows. The v11 sprint scripts are pure-numeric (PyTorch + lifelines) and do not invoke an LLM, so no token usage exists to optimize. The cost-proxy len(stdout)/1000 is a coarse byte-volume signal recorded for completeness, not a true cost.

That wiring is out of scope for this turn — track as v12 task: 'AgentOps three-pillar layer extends to Claude subagents'.
